name: Erwitte (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided yellow over red, charged at the centre with the city arms of Erwitte (a red lion on yellow and a yellow wolfsangel on red).
history: By deed of the Regierungspräsident in Arnsberg of 21 December 1977 the city of Erwitte was granted the right to bear a flag and a banner, described as yellow and red striped 1:1 with the city shield at the centre.
